name: My Fake Valentine
source:
You're painfully single. They just got stood up. One fake date between two strangers can't hurt... right?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/My_Fake_Valentine]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
你单身得令人痛苦。他们刚刚站起来。两个陌生人之间的一次假约会不会有什么坏处……对吧？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/My_Fake_Valentine]Choices Wikia[/url]]
